mirror_image_side — DRIVE pass op

• Data kinds: points → table

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.mirror_image_side(eye_xy, mirror_center_xy, mirror_normal_xy, points, *, heading, velocities=None) -> 'Dict[str, object]' (to call the implementation directly, import drivepass; drivepass.mirror_image_side(eye_xy, mirror_center_xy, mirror_normal_xy, points, *, heading, velocities=None) -> 'Dict[str, object]'; from the registry, opsdrive.get("mirror_image_side"))

Usage

Whether a point seen in a curve mirror appears to the left or right of the mirror center, and which way it appears to move (flat-mirror closed form). Scenarios S064, S130.

> The detailed description below is the original text — the summary and the headings are translated.

左右の向きは凸面鏡でも同じ(門で光線追跡と照合。凸面は角を縮めるだけ)。

上から見た 2 次元(x, y)。像 P' = P − 2((P − M)·n)n(drivedecide.mirror_reflection_matrix の 2 次元版)。image_offset = 眼から鏡の中心を見る向きに対する像の向きの角(+ = 左)。real_side = heading(運転者の前)に対して物が左(+1)か右(−1)か。velocities を渡すと image_motion = 像の角の速さ、direct_motion = 眼から物を直接見たときの角の速さ(遮りは見ない)、virtual_eye_motion = 仮想の眼 E' から見た角の速さ(= −image_motion が恒等式)、reversed = 像と直接の動きの向きが逆か。
